run_bump_version: run the bump_version script with a new version argument like 3.1.9 to update bjam version files
edit_file_with_regex: edit a file by applying regex replacements to update version strings in source files
make_edits_version: make edits to boost-jam.spec, build.jam, bjam.qbk, and patchlevel.h for a given version tuple
review_main_version_validation: review the main function that validates version arguments in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format before calling make_edits
refactor_edit_function: refactor the edit function to use context managers for safer file handling during regex replacements
